description:
The XP™ Lite is Lectric’s most accessible model to date. This unique eBike maintains the core features Lectric riders know and love about the original XP™ and XP™ 2.0 models, while being more maneuverable, lighter, and more compact. A twist grip throttle option and five levels of pedal assist allow you to own the roads with confidence and agility. This eBike’s single speed functionality is perfect for riders on-the-go and looking for a simple transportation solution. Ride anywhere, anytime with the epic Lectric XP™ Lite.

At just 46 lbs, this is one of the most affordable eBikes on the market.
A 300W nominal, 720W peak planetary geared motor achieves the perfect balance between torque and speed.
This eBike has the ability to reach a top speed of 20mph with pedal assist or throttle.**
The XP™ Lite is the only 48V eBike within its price range.
Foldable to just 36 L x 16 W x 27 H inches - making this one of the smallest folding eBikes in the industry.
Equipped with five levels of pedal assist to enhance the riding experience for all skill levels.
Twist throttle delivers pure power on demand.
Single speed drivetrain makes riding efficient and seamless.
Slim 20 x 2.4 inch tires allow you to turn on a dime.
A hidden and removable lithium-ion battery makes for a clean design while powering your ride for up to 40 miles on a single charge.*
An external charging port on the down tube provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. Meanwhile, interchangeable spare batteries can be removed and installed in seconds, doubling your range.
A backlit, heads-up LCD display provides trip and battery intelligence on the go.
160mm mechanical disc brakes offer peace of mind in both wet and dry conditions.
IP-65 rated electrical components ensure greater water and dust resistance.
Integrated front and rear lights allow you to be seen at night and provide you with greater safety.

We Go the Extra Mile

Every purchase from Lectric comes with unrivaled support from our US-based customer experience team.
Simply inflate your tires and consult a local bike technician for initial inspection.
All Lectric eBikes come with a one-year warranty.

** Where permitted by state law

* Range can vary due to weight load, terrain, weather and other conditions

Since the first Lectric eBikes release in 2019, our mission has been to create accessible and affordable electric bikes for the masses. With the support from an enthusiastic customer base, our team has been able to excel as one of the fastest growing eBike companies in the world. With each new eBike model, we aim to empower riders from coast to coast to explore with confidence, and have fun while they’re at it. Adventure starts here!
